items.title: The FAA grounds every flight in America
items.summary: A telecom failure in air traffic control led the FAA to halt departures at every US airport for over four hours, the longest nationwide grounding since 9/11. Nearly 10,000 flights were canceled into the weekend.
items.author: @flightradar24

post.name: Flightradar24
post.text: Issued by the FAA just moments ago, ALL US airports are currently ground stopped. This means NO flights may depart for US airports. Flights already in the air will be allowed to land. This is related to an FAA equipment outage.
